title: Accounts, identity, and tenancy
intro: AWS security starts with account boundaries, organization guardrails, IAM roles and policies, SaaS tenant isolation patterns, and consistent tagging across environments.

overviewDiagram.title: Identity and tenancy flow
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  ACC[Account boundary] --> ORG[Organizations + SCPs]
  ORG --> IAM[IAM roles and policies]
  IAM --> TENANT[Multi-tenant isolation]
  TENANT --> TAGS[Tags and environments]

conceptCards.title: Account boundary
conceptCards.summary: 12-digit account ID is the hardest default isolation — separate prod from dev at account level.
conceptCards.example: AssumeRole with ExternalId for cross-account CI deploy.

conceptCards.title: Organizations and SCPs
conceptCards.summary: SCPs filter maximum permissions — deny guardrails on OUs, never grant.

conceptCards.title: IAM fundamentals
conceptCards.summary: Roles for services, SSO for humans. Explicit Deny wins. Least privilege with conditions.
conceptCards.example: Lambda execution role with s3:GetObject on one prefix.

conceptCards.title: Multi-tenant isolation
conceptCards.summary: Silo, pool, or bridge — AWS provides boundaries; app enforces tenant_id everywhere.
conceptCards.example: DynamoDB partition key tenantId for pooled model.

conceptCards.title: Tags and environments
conceptCards.summary: Tags for cost and automation; accounts for security. Enforce at resource creation.
conceptCards.example: SCP denies RunInstances without Environment tag.

mindmap
